title: barista release manifest
description: Release manifest published as a GitHub release asset (release.json); consumed by barista upgrade. Scope: a self-description of one release (version, commit, asset inventory) — no release notes, CI metadata or build-report content

commit.description: Full SHA of the git commit the release was built from

assets.description: Every asset of the release. Executable archives carry kind executable-zip/executable-tgz plus platforms and entry; platform-agnostic assets omit platforms. New kinds and fields may be added without bumping schemaVersion (clients ignore what they do not know)

kind.description: Asset role and container format, e.g. executable-zip / executable-tgz / checksums; vocabulary is convention, not enum, so new kinds stay valid

platforms.description: Platforms the asset applies to (<goos>/<goarch>); omit for platform-agnostic assets

file.description: Asset file name in the same release

entry.description: Path of the barista binary inside an executable archive (barista or barista.exe); other entries are extras like LICENSE and completions

url.description: Optional absolute download URL (e.g. a mirror copy); clients fall back to <release base>/<file>

hashes.description: Content hashes of the asset file; sha256 is required, other algorithms may be added
